title: Graceful Quarantine & Deferred Retry Controller for Hosted 5xx/Timeout Surges
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Summary: During recent customer escalations we observed correlated 5xx bursts and timeouts driven by simultaneous retries and long-tail inflight requests. This ticket implements a new runtime-level controller that quarantines suspect request streams at tenant scope and applies deferred, transactional-aware retries to reduce amplification while preserving fast recovery for healthy traffic.

Goals:
- Prevent retry amplification from causing cascading 5xx waves across hosted tenants.
- Apply context-aware deferment of retries for non-idempotent or long-running requests.
- Provide operators and SREs an observable quarantine window and emergency unblock path.

Scope: Implement controller in the edge/proxy and gateway layers with a lightweight tenant-scoped state machine, instrumentation into tracing, and SDK-compatible headers to communicate idempotency and transactional hints.
acceptance_criteria:
- Controller can detect surge patterns (threshold: > 5x baseline 5xx rate per tenant in 1min) and move new requests into Quarantine state.
- Quarantined requests are fast-failed or queued for deferred retry according to idempotency hint.
- SDK header X-RW-Idempotency or request body hint is honored: non-idempotent requests receive no automatic retries; idempotent requests use bounded exponential-backoff with tenant-hysteresis.
- Dashboard surfaces quarantine counts, average deferred latency, and rollback reason.
- SRE can toggle quarantine for a tenant via Console and via admin API.
- No regressions in p95/p99 production latency for unaffected tenants (<= 2% change) after rollout.
implementation_notes:
- New module: gateway/quarantine_controller.go + proxy middleware.
- TenantScope maintains sliding-window counters (10s, 60s) and a short TTL token when quarantine is active.
- Retry decision uses (idempotency_hint, content_length, kv_cache_state, trace_sampling) to avoid replays of long KV-backed streaming requests.
- Backoff policy: initial_delay=200ms, multiplier=1.8, max_retries=3 for idempotent; non-idempotent -> fast-fail and surface to caller.
- Add header X-RW-Quarantine: active|deferred|fastfail and X-RW-Quarantine-Reason.
- Persist minimal quarantine events in events table for 48h retention for postmortem analysis.
- Safety: controller defaults to opt-in per-tenant; global switch in Console for emergency enable/disable.
work_log:
2025-02-15: Triage and scope defined with SRE and PM.
2025-02-18: Prototype gating logic in local gateway, unit tests for sliding-window counters.
2025-02-24: Design review with Runtime and SDK teams; agreed on headers and idempotency hints.
2025-02-27: End-to-end integration test harness for simulated tenant bursts implemented.
2025-03-02: Began incremental rollout plan and signed off monitoring metrics.
decisions:
- Use tenant-scoped quarantine (not global) to preserve noisy-neighbor isolation.
- Use headers for cross-component signaling rather than changing request bodies.
- Keep default max_retries conservative (3) to limit token churn and KV cache pressure.
- Opt-in per-tenant to avoid unexpected behavior for Dedicated/Private customers; Console will expose toggle for hosted customers.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for sliding window counters, state transitions, header propagation.
- Load tests: synthetic tenant surge (10k rps -> 50k rps) with mixed idempotent/non-idempotent traffic.
- Chaos run: introduce backend latency and validate quarantine prevents system-wide retry storms.
- Canary rollout to 5 low-risk tenants, then 20, then full rollout with guardrails.
- Regression test suite for SDKs to ensure header compatibility.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge feature flag behind runtime-1.22 gate.
2) Deploy to staging and run synthetic surge tests.
3) Canary #1: enable for 5 internal tenants for 48h; monitor metrics.
4) Canary #2: enable for 20 low-traffic tenants and run 72h.
5) Gradual 10%->50%->100% ramp with rollback window and automated alert thresholds.
6) Post-rollout: 1-week observation and tweak backoff/threshold parameters.
monitoring_runbook:
- Metrics: quarantine_active_tenants, quarantine_deferred_requests, quarantine_fastfail_count, post_quarantine_cooldown_events, average_deferred_latency.
- Alerts: >0.5% of total tenants in quarantine for >15min -> paging.
- If p95 latency increases >10% for non-quarantined tenants after rollout -> rollback.
- SRE playbook: verify admin toggle, check events table for quarantine triggers, capture flamegraphs for backend latency.
- Emergency unblock: admin API POST /admin/tenants/{id}/quarantine/unblock with audit log entry.
notes_for_customers: Customer facing summary (for escalations): We are deploying a protective mechanism that isolates unusual retry-heavy traffic for a short period and defers retries for idempotent requests. This reduces the impact of cascading 5xx errors while preserving correctness. We will communicate per-customer incidents with time window and whether automated retries were deferred.
next_steps:

- Run full synthetic chaos tests and validate metrics (2d).
